plan.failureSummary: Deterministic cache replay selected the 'Solutions' nav dropdown instead of 'Developers' due to a stale nth-of-type selector, causing the flow to navigate to a solutions use-case page instead of docs.
observedIndicators: The cached page.ai runSource targets `#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button` for the Developers dropdown.
Tool history shows this selector resolved to the 'Solutions' button (`aria-controls=\"nav-dropdown-solutions\"`).
The live screenshot shows the navbar order is Product, Solutions, Developers, making Developers the 3rd item rather than the 2nd.
Navigation ended at `https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/`, causing the user assertion `expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/')` to fail.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai deterministic cache and re-run test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the page.ai deterministic cache for checkly.test.ts so that page.ai can autonomously identify and interact with the Developers menu and Documentation link.

plan.notes: The 'Developers' dropdown is intact and visible in the live navigation header. Clearing the stale page.ai deterministic cache and allowing page.ai to re-evaluate the target element will resolve the issue.
